reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding; additionally the function is an exported public Next.js Server Action, satisfying the public API exception). Gate 2 passed: entry point is an unauthenticated public HTTP endpoint, not a trusted data source. Gate 3 passed: src/app/actions.ts is explicitly in-scope and QR registration flow is a listed key security concern. Code confirmed at L161-170: no rate-limit, no window count query, no DB constraint — each unauthenticated call DELETEs all incomplete temp_registrations for the target card_id then INSERTs a fresh one. An attacker can trigger this via the public createTempRegistration Server Action endpoint by sending rapid unauthenticated POST requests with a victim's card_id, causing continuous DELETE+INSERT cycles on temp_registrations that invalidate the victim's active QR token and prevent card enrollment from completing (registration DoS). Severity MEDIUM retained; no deployment_context.client_diversity cap applicable.
